thz504-ha.idMapTip: Key → entity id, e.g. "exv_opening": "thz504_diag_exv_oeffnung"; status bits as "operating_status.compressor". Lets new sensors take over the ids of old entities. Delete the old entity in Home Assistant first so history and statistics continue.
thz504-ha.tip: Entities are named sensor.<entity prefix>_<key> in Home Assistant, e.g. sensor.thz504_outdoor_temp. If entities with this prefix already exist, choose another prefix while running in parallel, e.g. thz504can.
